name: Sacred Path Ascendant
summary: Your Sacred Path reaches its heroic form. Sacred Path Ascendant Feature Preacher Allies within 30 ft also gain +1d4 to fear saves. Flagellant The first time each round you take damage, gain temporary HP equal to twice your proficiency bonus. Purifier When you deal fire damage, one affected creature cannot benefit from cover against your next attack before your next turn.
